note: The DECODE-PINNED configuration the eval suite runs each family under, recorded so a run is reproducible (design impl-review-v1 §3.5: 'a decode-pinned configuration recorded in the eval provenance'; PRD §5.9: 'recorded in EVT-4's provenance'). This is the run protocol AS DATA: N (the fixed per-family run count, >= 5), the pinned decode parameters (temperature/top_p/seed) the live lenses run under, and the model + prompts + calibration versions the run evaluated. The hermetic harness reads N and the caught-every-run rule from here; the gated live suite (build tag `eval`) additionally pins the decode parameters against the real backend.
